compiled CLI starts and stops its sibling native receiver without a checkout or Bun on PATH

testcase.name: internal oracle neutralizes nonfinite values; external validator refuses them
digital trigger release restores independent analog hold
contract rejects malformed, unknown, duplicate, missing and out-of-range data
decoded state has independent immutable ownership
signed axis ties match Swift/Rust rounding away from zero
pairing proof succeeds once; public status and admission receipt omit bootstrap material
wrong ID and malformed secrets each spend one attempt and exhaust the window
a valid final allowed proof succeeds without granting another attempt
expiry boundary, replacement, cancellation, restart and entropy failure retire old material
clock rollback and invalid clocks fail closed rather than extending pairing
authority and window identities domain-separate the stored verifier
pairing decoders reject extra fields, inconsistent state, malformed values and accessors
portable pairing client refuses a different authority and secret-bearing status replies
portable modules cannot import platform code, host policy or escape through relative paths
portable domain imports and ordinary document variables remain valid
mobile control maps are bounded, immutable and share native semantic fixtures
invalid native maps cannot be admitted through the JS configuration boundary
mobile map getters cannot execute and source mutation cannot edit an admitted map
native bridge configuration requires the matching activation receipt
native control lists reject holes and accessor elements without executing them
typed local client handles repeated success and rejection without leaking connections
